doc:
# Volume Conjecture — Complexity

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “complexity equals volume”).

claims.name: holographic_complexity_analyzed_using_both
claims.statement: Holographic complexity is analyzed using both the complexity-equals-action and complexity-equals-volume conjectures.

sources.title: Holographic complexity of rotating black holes

claims.name: within_complexity_volume_conjecture_subregion
claims.statement: Within the complexity = volume conjecture, subregion complexity equals holographic purification complexity.

claims.name: within_complexity_spacetime_volume_conjecture
claims.statement: Within the complexity = spacetime volume conjecture, subregion complexity equals holographic purification complexity.

claims.name: complexity_computed_using_complexity_equals
claims.statement: The complexity is computed using the complexity equals volume (CV) conjecture.

claims.name: conjecture_implies_proposals_complexity_equals
claims.statement: The conjecture implies that the proposals 'complexity equals action' and 'complexity equals volume' can represent the same physics.

sources.title: Holographic Cavalieri Principle as a Universal relation between Holographic Complexity and Holographic Entanglement Entropy

claims.name: both_complexity_equals_action_complexity
claims.statement: In both complexity equals action and complexity equals volume prescriptions, the relative complexity between subextremal and extremal AdS black holes diverges logarithmically.

sources.title: Holographic Complexity, Extremality, and Cosmic Censorship

claims.name: evaluate_complexity_equals_volume_cv
claims.statement: We evaluate the Complexity equals Volume (CV) conjecture and extend the analysis to codimension-zero proposals, specifically Complexity equals Spacetime Volume (CV2.0) and Complexity equals Action (CA), through the Wheeler-DeWitt (WDW) patch we construct.

sources.title: Holographic complexity of de-Sitter black holes

claims.name: thermodynamic_volume_rather_than_entropy
claims.statement: The thermodynamic volume, rather than the entropy, is suggested to control the complexity of formation of large black holes in both the complexity equals action and complexity equals volume proposals.

claims.name: quantum_complexity_overline_deformation_evaluated
claims.statement: The quantum complexity of $ T\overline{T} $-deformation is evaluated via holography using the complexity equals volume (CV) and complexity equals action (CA) proposals.

sources.title: Quantum Complexity of $T\bar{T}$-deformation and Its Implications

claims.name: both_complexity_equals_volume_cv
claims.statement: Both the complexity equals volume (CV) and complexity equals action (CA) conjectures are used to track the post-quench evolution.

sources.title: Holographic local quench and effective complexity

claims.name: analysis_follows_complexityequalsvolume_cv_conjecture
claims.statement: The analysis follows the complexity-equals-volume (CV) conjecture.

sources.title: On the Complexity of a $2+1$--dimensional Holographic Superconductor

claims.name: comparison_complexity_equals_volume_cv
claims.statement: Comparison with the “complexity equals volume” (CV) proposal shows that generalized volume complexity probes a more complete black hole interior.

sources.title: Complexity equals anything for multi-horizon black holes

claims.name: solitons_tested_holographic_complexity_equals
claims.statement: The solitons are tested in the holographic complexity equals action and complexity equals volume conjectures as examples with nontrivial rotation and topology.

sources.title: Chemistry and Complexity for Solitons in AdS$_5$

claims.name: holographic_complexity_slowly_accelerating_kerrads
claims.statement: Holographic complexity of a slowly accelerating Kerr-AdS black hole is investigated using the complexity equals action (CA) and complexity equals volume (CV) conjectures in bulk Einstein gravity.

sources.title: Holographic complexity of rotating black holes with conical deficits

claims.name: deformation_produces_strong_signal_supporting
claims.statement: The deformation produces a strong signal supporting the complexity equals volume conjecture.

claims.name: ads_gravitational_solitons_display_black
claims.statement: AdS₅ gravitational solitons display black hole-like mass and thermodynamic properties, including a topologically induced thermodynamic volume. In both the complexity-equals-action and complexity-equals-volume conjectures, their complexity of formation scales as $V^{3/4}$, identical to large black holes.

sources.title: Chemistry and Complexity for Solitons in AdS$_5$

claims.name: rotating_black_holes_thermodynamic_volume
claims.statement: For rotating black holes, the thermodynamic volume—not the entropy—is proposed to control the complexity of formation in both complexity equals action and complexity equals volume conjectures; this proposal reproduces known entropy-based results when volume and entropy are dependent and establishes that the complexity is bounded below by entropy for large black holes.

claims.name: using_complexityequalsaction_complexityequalsvolume_proposals_odddimensional
claims.statement: Using the complexity-equals-action and complexity-equals-volume proposals for odd-dimensional equal-spinning rotating black holes, the paper finds that the complexity of formation is directly connected to thermodynamic volume for large black holes. It also shows that the late-time complexity growth rate approaches a constant while generically violating Lloyd's bound.

sources.title: Holographic complexity of rotating black holes
